Careers

Benefits of Atlas

Meaningful Impact

Join a team where your voice matters. At Atlas Invest, you’re empowered to own your projects, make critical decisions, and see the direct results of your contributions shaping our success.

Unlimited Growth

Head of Capital Formation (Real Estate Credit) (NYC)

Atlas Invest | New York, NY | Hybrid | Reports to the CEO

Atlas Invest has built the origination engine, the credit framework, and the technology. This seat brings the institutional capital that matches them.
Atlas is an AI-native real estate credit platform backed by BlackRock. We originate first-lien bridge loans across US metro markets and deliver them to investors through forward-flow separately managed accounts. The constraint on the business is not deal flow or credit quality. It is how fast institutional capital gets committed. This is a closing seat.

WHAT YOU WILL BE SELLING
• First-lien bridge loans, $200K to $15M, twelve-month average term, up to 70% LTV, US metro markets
• Managed account structure, $5M minimum ticket, and a return that comes from a structural gap rather than leverage or reaching on credit
• Credit framework, operating model, and technology built together, not bolted on: proprietary AI across sourcing, underwriting, and asset management, with 24-hour forward-flow approval on loans that fit the box
• Real-time portfolio access and reporting for investors, the first thing an allocator’s diligence team asks for
• A team that has closed more than $500M of bridge loans and more than $7B of real estate transactions

WHAT YOU WILL OWN
• First meeting to funded account: the right allocators, the room, diligence to completion, terms, closing
• One channel: separately managed accounts from family offices, RIAs and wealth platforms, insurance investment offices, and private credit funds. No leverage providers, no loan buyers in year one
• The pitch, the objections, and the pipeline discipline. Leadership owns the data room, loan tape, reporting, and ODD responses
• A running start: allocator deck, leverage facility, live institutional conversations, an advisor network opening doors with you. Headcount follows capital milestones

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
• 90 days: investor universe mapped and tiered, live dialogue with allocators you brought, two SMA mandates in diligence
• 6 months: first SMA of $50M or more funded and deploying. This is the milestone that matters, and it carries a defined award
• 12 months: second and third accounts in diligence or funded, and a pipeline that is systematic rather than personal

WHO YOU ARE
• A book you can name: the allocators you can get on the phone in thirty days, the individual at each, and the honest basis of the relationship.
• A record of closing capital, not covering it: lead relationship on commitments of $25M or more, introduction through funding. SMA or forward-flow experience is the strongest signal. Placement agent backgrounds welcome
• Credit fluency: you can hold a real conversation about first-lien bridge collateral, where the loss content sits, and what happens when a borrower does not perform
• 8+ years in capital raising, investor relations, or business development at a private credit, real estate debt, or alternatives manager, or a placement agent. Familiar with ODD questionnaires, data rooms, and investor reporting
• New York based or commutable, hybrid. Bachelor’s degree required

COMPENSATION AND PROCESS
Year-one total cash compensation is expected to range from $100,000 to $500,000 or more, driven by what you close.

Process: a screening call, leadership interviews, and a ninety-minute working session on a real Atlas allocator problem. Confidential conversations welcome. Atlas Invest is an equal opportunity employer.

Position: Full time
Location: New York, U.S. (hybrid)

    VP Risk & Underwriting (NYC)

    About Atlas Invest

    We operate in a large, highly fragmented market that has historically relied on manual processes, disconnected systems, and local lending relationships. Atlas combines deep real estate credit expertise with technology to create a faster, more consistent, and highly scalable lending platform.

    Our current focus is mid-market real estate bridge lending, with a particular emphasis on multifamily, residential, and mixed-use assets. We are building toward a much larger vision: an institutional-grade platform capable of originating, underwriting, managing, and scaling real estate credit across markets, asset classes, and lending products.

    We are looking for a VP, Risk & Underwriting to lead that effort.

    About the Role

    The VP, Risk & Underwriting will own Atlas’s credit and underwriting function and play a central role in building the risk infrastructure required to scale the company. Reporting directly to the CEO, this person will lead our underwriting team and own the full credit lifecycle, from initial deal screening and underwriting through investment committee, loan processing, closing, and ongoing portfolio monitoring.

    This is not a traditional bank underwriting role. We are looking for someone who combines deep real estate credit judgment with a builder mentality. You will make key credit decisions while building the processes, systems, policies, and team that allow Atlas to operate consistently and at scale. Over time, you will also help expand Atlas beyond its current mid-market bridge lending strategy into additional asset classes, lending products, and segments of the real estate credit market.

    Responsibilities

    • Manage and mentor our analyst and underwriting team to uphold high-quality deal assessments and minimize errors
    • Own underwriting standards, credit policies, investment committees, and risk management
    • Build institutional-grade processes that allow us to increase volume while maintaining disciplined credit standards
    • Partner closely with Product and R&D to automate underwriting, loan processing, monitoring, and other credit workflows
    • Remain hands-on with complex transactions and key credit decisions
    • Provide insight on market trends and borrower behavior to help guide broader investment strategy and pricing models

    Requirements:

    • 10+ years of real estate credit and underwriting experience
    • 5+ years specifically underwriting mid-market bridge loans, including multifamily, mixed-use, single-family, and other property types
    • Deep expertise across underwriting, structuring, due diligence, closing, and portfolio risk management
    • Proven experience leading underwriting or credit teams
    • A builder mentality and track record of creating or improving credit processes, rather than simply operating within established ones
    • Comfortable operating with the speed, ownership, and ambiguity of a high-growth startup

    Position: Full time
    Location: New York, U.S. (hybrid)

      Senior Product Manager (TLV)

      Atlas Invest is building the AI-Native Infrastructure for Real Estate Credit. Following our recent partnership with BlackRock, we’re entering a rapid growth phase to scale the business.

      We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager, reporting to the CPO, to execute on the product roadmap and innovation. You’ll take high-level direction, a market constraint, a “we need to own this workflow end to end”, and turn it into a specification precise enough to build against, then carry it from definition through deployment.

      What you’ll do

      • Translate company roadmap into deliverable requirements (PRDs): user stories, states, edge cases, data contracts, acceptance criteria, success metrics
      • Work closely alongside software engineers to align on technical specifications, feature requests, and workflow optimizations
      • Own the full delivery cycle: discovery, definition, design partnership, sprint execution, QA, launch, adoption
      • Design for genuinely different personas with conflicting needs: underwriters and analysts who live in the product all day, deal flow partners who touch it a few times per deal, borrowers who see it once, and credit stakeholders who need to trust its output
      • Work directly with analysts and underwriters to understand the real workflow, including the parts that happen outside the system
      • Define where automation ends and human judgment begins, and make those checkpoints legible in the UI
      • Apply strong analytical skills to establish clear KPIs, ensuring product deliverables generate measurable business impact rather than just task completion.

      What we’re looking for

      • 5+ years in product, with meaningful time on complex B2B platforms serving multiple distinct personas
      • Possess a leverage-focused mindset, preferring to engineer autonomous agents to execute complex workflows rather than doing them manually.
      • Proven experience defining a complex fintech platform end to end, lending/mortgage/credit/LOS, capital markets, banking infrastructure, or comparable
      • Strong UI/UX instincts. You can sit with a designer as a peer, critique a flow with specificity, and recognize when a screen is hiding complexity instead of resolving it
      • Comfortable with ambiguity and with technical depth: you can reason about data models, pipelines, and where an AI system will be unreliable
      • Obsessive attention to detail: states, empty cases, error paths, permissions, what happens when the document is blurry and the borrower’s name is spelled three ways
      • Fluent English; comfortable working across time zones with a team spanning New York, Israel, Poland, Spain, and Portugal

      Nice to have

      • Experience shipping AI-native or agentic products, especially where model output feeds a decision a human is accountable for
      • Background in design or engineering before product

      Join a groundbreaking fintech startup where your work truly matters, surrounded by a fast-paced, collaborative team that’s building something extraordinary. We offer a competitive salary, full benefits, and equity ownership, plus the chance to work hands-on with cutting-edge technologies that are reshaping the future of finance.

      Position: Full-time
      Location: Tel Aviv, Israel

        About the Role & Responsibilities

            Tal Shahar

            Co-Founder and CEO

            Co-Founder and CEO of Atlas Invest, Tal Shahar leads the company in revolutionizing asset-backed debt investments. With over a decade of experience in fintech and financial strategy, Tal’s commitment to delivering impactful results is rooted in a deep passion for financial innovation. Prior to founding Atlas, he was a key member of the founding team at Deep Insight, a venture capital firm specializing in deep tech, where he continues to serve as a Venture Partner. Tal’s dedication to strategic execution and team development has solidified Atlas Invest as a trusted partner for those seeking secure, asset-backed debt opportunities.

            Tal’s career has been defined by his ability to combine financial expertise with a forward-thinking approach to technology and markets. He launched his first fintech startup, Athoss, while pursuing degrees in Computer Science and Entrepreneurship. He also established the influential investment community HiveMind, further showcasing his talent for connecting vision with execution. These experiences laid the groundwork for the creation of Atlas Invest, where Tal integrates his knowledge of computer science, financial strategy, and market dynamics to deliver innovative solutions in real estate-backed debt investments.

            Known for his results-driven leadership style, Tal places a strong emphasis on teamwork and shared purpose. His collaborative approach and relentless focus on delivering value have propelled Atlas Invest into a position of trust and excellence in the industry. Tal’s ability to bridge deep industry insights with cutting-edge technology continues to drive Atlas forward, offering secure and scalable opportunities in asset-backed debt markets.
